title: The Famous Door and Pittsburgh, John Hammond and Willard Alexander
summary: The band played the tiny Famous Door in New York and the Chatterbox in Pittsburgh, where George Simon and Hammond heard them.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Yes, yes. Well now after, let's see, you got to New York and we've got .....
Got to the Apollo Theater.
What?
We've got to the Apollo Theater.
Right. Now when does Billie Holiday come into that band?

Oh, Billie didn't come until later. You see, you've got to remember that we went into the Famous Door. That was one of the biggest, our big event in New York. That place was so little, it was such a small place that nobody thought you could get all of our band in there. But we did get in there and we took up maybe one third of the whole place. It was just a place like a box.
Whose ideas was it to go in there?
I think it was Willard Alexander and John Hammond. They were doing everything and they were the ones that brought us out of Kansas City, put us into Roseland. Put us out in Pittsburgh.
Where did you play in Pittsburgh?
You know, I've forgotten the name of it.
Oh, was it, I mean was it a theater or .....
It was an hotel.
Oh, an hotel?
I remember we played in a room called the 'Chatterbox'. I can't think of the name of it now. In fact, that was where George Simon wrote the band up like he did about us being out of tune.
In Pittsburgh? What was he doing up there? I thought he was.......
He went up there to see us with John Hammond and boy, he told everybody in the East we got the greatest band coming. They went all

the way out to Pittsburgh just to hear us. All they could say was we were swinging like hell, but we weren't ... And then we left there and went to, into Chicago. And then we started, that's when we started making changes and getting guys like Dickie Wells, Benny Morton, Eddie Durham.
We stayed, oh we did so many times in the Famous Door, in and out, in and out. We stayed around there for a long time.
: What I'm curious about though is how they managed to pay any money in a little box like that.
Well, they paid more than we got at the Savoy and that's a big place and we made thirty-three dollars a week. I guess more rich people come down in there.
